title: Mobile-responsive Textual workspace and inline artifact-apply UX convergence
gate_window_position: 1/1 implementation remediation; native targeted validation owned by this overlay
supersedes: pres_ux01_textual_workspace_revamp_v4.zip (applied transactionally, native validation failed, rolled back cleanly; real Textual interaction regressions reproduced locally under Textual 8.2.8)

merge_window_decision.reason: Normal execution, standalone control-center interaction, and artifact-apply presentation share the same concrete Textual boundary. The changes converge presentation only and preserve canonical execution/lifecycle authority. Screenshot evidence from the pre-UX01 apply host is folded into this same overlay rather than creating a premature UX02.

promises.text: Give normal execution and artifact application a shared responsive Textual workspace hierarchy instead of unrelated one-off layouts.
Make artifact apply launched from the control center visible inline by reusing the canonical H02 managed-child source rather than spawning a detached invisible apply process.
Replace the permanently crowded global action strip with page-contextual actions and preserve keyboard discoverability.
Keep the TUI usable on compact Termux terminals through shared width and height breakpoints, including keyboard-constrained mobile viewports, while preserving state and cancellation access.
Preserve RUN/EXO/LIFE/validation/transaction truth ownership; stage rails, counters, summaries, parsed pytest child progress, and status labels remain renderer-only projections.
Require targeted native Textual App.run_test/Pilot validation for all modified concrete surfaces before the artifact may qualify.

Collapse the six-row artifact review after execution begins, bound long artifact/path/test text, and let the live log flex into all remaining vertical space without overlapping or stale resize geometry.

Do not pin artifact apply at a deceptive 0% while validation is active: show canonical progress when known, explicit pytest validation-child progress when observed, otherwise render progress as indeterminate.

Keep raw validator output recoverable while defaulting the primary log to an activity view that suppresses repetitive pytest dots/separators/heartbeat spam; provide a raw/activity toggle without discarding captured lines.

Exercise realistic phone/tmux/keyboard terminal sizes in the mandatory native Textual matrix, including 48x14, 52x20, and a wider recovery size, and prove log geometry remains non-overlapping after live resize.
